import.method: git archive --format=tar HEAD from the pinned detached checkout, extracted verbatim; no export-ignore, no submodules, no symlinks, no LFS pointers in this tree

local_patches.reason: Track diagnostics completion through LSP pull/publish protocol, including complete-empty publications, without stale cached fallback; semantic boundary patch also rejects external source reads before serialization.
local_patches.test_evidence: python3 -m py_compile vendor/serena/src/serena/lazy_read_api.py vendor/serena/src/solidlsp/ls.py; npm --prefix packages/core run build; node scripts/verify-semantic.mjs (producer awaits main captured-map integration).

rules: The import commit is upstream verbatim. Every later change is a separate commit and a local_patches entry.
A local_patches entry records original_blob, resulting_blob, reason and test evidence.
Distribution artefacts (npm tarball, PyPI wheel) are never a substitute for this source.
added_files_note: Files lazy-intel adds inside the vendor tree. They are ours, not upstream's, and carry an ADDED BY lazy-intel header. lazy_read_api.py is the typed, read-only semantic boundary (symbols, references, diagnostics), including explicit truncation metadata, and is tracked here as an intentional addition; verify-vendor.mjs accepts exactly these as non-drift.
